name: United Arab Emirates
note: FCSC December 2005 federal census: national and seven emirates. Separately, SCAD 2023 R1 revised/2024 administrative-register counts: Abu Dhabi and three regions only. Two indicators, 15 observations; the series are not merged. Current comparable all-emirate values, codes/boundaries, actual planning documents, source terms and independent acceptance unresolved.

name: Azerbaijan
note: Official SSC table 1.15 2019 census-basis and 2026 resident population plus table 1.19 2026 sex: 4 local indicators and 403 direct observations across national, 14 parents and 86 children. 84 of 87 2024 first-level code candidates adopted; three city/district conflicts held. 2019 census volumes acquired but not fully audited; official local polygons, planning/fiscal content and independent acceptance unresolved.

name: Israel
note: Official CBS 2022 Census: 8 direct indicators and 64 observations across national and seven first-level reporting rows; area 7 is Israeli localities in Judea and Samaria only, not all residents. Six acquired workbooks have 14 sheets with only eight fields of one sheet adopted. No verified local polygons, planning/fiscal content or independent acceptance.

name: Lebanon
note: Official CAS LFHLCS 2018-19 household survey Table 1.1/HL.5: national, eight governorates and 26 source caza, four indicators and 140 direct mid-2018 observations for residential-dwelling residents. Not a census or all-resident count; two coextensive governorate/caza pairs retained separately. Other CAS tables/MICS, official codes/boundaries, plans/fiscal evidence, source terms and independent acceptance unresolved.

name: State of Palestine
note: PCBS updated 2017 census summary Tables 2/29: national, two regions, 16 governorates, two Jerusalem reporting zones and 585 coded localities; four indicators and 1837 direct observations. Includes post-enumeration estimates, not present population. J1 is aggregate-only; 29 J2 localities cover J2. Eight updated codes absent from May 2017 guide. Other source tables, official boundary/legal typing, plans/fiscal evidence, terms and independent acceptance unresolved.

Other tables, official municipality codes/compatible polygons, current planning and fiscal content, source terms and independent acceptance unresolved.

name: Armenia
note: Official ArmStat 2022 census Chapter 1 two selected tables: national, Yerevan and 12 districts, ten marzes and 70 marz communities; six direct indicators and 564 observations. Other 55 workbooks, source terms, full planning/fiscal contents and independent acceptance remain unresolved.

Official codes/polygons, current planning/fiscal bodies, terms and independent acceptance unresolved.

All 410 locality and 99 quarter codes occur in the older official 2015 GEOCODES ledger; current boundaries/councils not matched. Local-plan catalogue and 2026 process located but plan/fiscal bodies unacquired; source terms, full acceptance and hosting unresolved.
